description: Look up one of your short links by code: destination, click count, status, and expiry. Use get_url_stats for clicks per day and where they came from.

code.description: The link's short code (e.g. AbCdEf, or launch for gajo.io/c/launch). A full short URL also works.

name: get_url

appLink.description: App links only: where iOS and Android go, and the page other devices see.

expiresDate.description: ISO-8601 instant; null when the link never expires.

title: Get a short link
